stem: Under Section 10 of RA 9003, the barangay handles the segregation and collection of biodegradable, compostable and reusable wastes. Who is responsible for collecting non-recyclable materials and special wastes?
hints: Section 10 splits the collection work between two levels of local government.
The first level is named in the question. The rule for the other kinds of waste starts with "Provided, That ..."
Read that proviso: the collection of non-recyclable materials and special wastes "shall be the responsibility of the ..." Find the level it names among the choices.

solution.methodName: Name who is responsible, then check the exact role

steps.action: Recall Section 10: "Segregation and collection of solid waste shall be conducted at the barangay level specifically for biodegradable, compostable and reusable wastes."
Read the proviso that follows: "the collection of non-recyclable materials and special wastes shall be the responsibility of the municipality or city."
steps.why: A proviso is a "Provided, That" clause. It adds a condition or an exception to the rule before it.

steps.action: Note that Section 10 makes LGUs "primarily responsible for the implementation and enforcement" of RA 9003. The DENR supports them.
steps.why: This is why a national agency like the DENR is not the collector.

steps.action: The answer is the municipality or city.

trapNotes.The barangay: The barangay handles biodegradable, compostable and reusable wastes. Non-recyclable and special wastes go to the municipality or city.
trapNotes.The province: The province has a Solid Waste Management Board (Section 11), but Section 10 does not name it as the collector.
trapNotes.The DENR regional office: Section 10 makes LGUs primarily responsible for carrying out RA 9003. The DENR gives technical help (Section 8) but does not collect garbage.
